info.about: Battletoads/Double Dragon is a 1993 beat 'em up developed by Rare and published by Tradewest. It was originally released for the Nintendo Entertainment System and later ported to the Mega Drive/Genesis, Super NES, and Game Boy.
info.trivia: The Game Boy version is single-player only and drops the NES original's 3D effects, keeping the same sprite sizes on a smaller screen.
info.why: Limited Run Games and Retro-Bit have reissued the cartridge, yet loose 1993 Tradewest originals still ask more than the sealed reissues.
